name: socioconnect
description: Draft, preview, and publish content across 40+ social platforms with explicit approval before anything goes live.

interface.shortDescription: Draft once, publish everywhere, with approval.
interface.longDescription: SocioConnect composes a single master draft, adapts it per platform, validates limits, and publishes or schedules across social accounts. Every public post requires an explicit preview and confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Draft and schedule next week's posts for my connected accounts.
Repurpose this blog post into an X thread, LinkedIn post, and newsletter.
Audit my schedule for gaps and duplicates.
